Outlook • Focus on delivery of strategic in-fill developments at Two Rivers (apartments), Vipingo (Lifestyle Centre and Industrial Park) and Pearl Marina (apartments) Real Estate • Aggressive sales of construction ready sites as well as bulk land sales − Several large transactions in the pipeline across the portfolio • Pursuing equity investors at development level (Vipingo, Pearl Marina) • Positive growth outlook for majority of underlying portfolio companies on the Growth back of our active portfolio management strategy Portfolio • Expect to close exits currently in the pipeline at valuations significantly higher than current carrying values of the respective assets • Construction of first school remains on track, with project development activities Development underway for additional locations in the region Portfolio • Anticipate significant focus on the Healthcare sector, with current expectations being that we will progress to execution phase during the balance of FY 2018 • Our outlook on the markets is positive Marketable • We anticipate investing a portion of proceeds from exits in the Growth Portfolio Securities and Real Estate transactions into our Marketable Securities portfolio to increase its weighting in our overall asset allocation 55
